caption:
Water clashes with lightning in a dark forest.
Seedance 2.0 generated every frame of this.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, cinematic live-action anime adaptation, dark samurai realism, 35mm anamorphic lens, high-contrast cool moonlight color grade, explosive particle lighting, rapid dynamic pacing.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WATER SWORDSMAN: A 20-year-old warrior with short dark tousled hair, piercing gray eyes, wearing a deep navy-blue layered robe with silver wave embroidery and dark leather arm guards, wielding a straight steel katana.
- THE LIGHTNING WARRIOR: A 19-year-old agile fighter with platinum-blonde undercut hair, striking amber eyes, wearing a charcoal-gray tunic with crimson lightning-bolt motifs across the chest and shoulders, wielding a sleek gold-trimmed blade.

LOCATION:
Deep misty pine forest at midnight, damp dark soil, drifting low-hanging fog, silvery moonlight filtering through dense evergreen branches.

SHOTS:
SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:06.0) — Water Stance & Dragon Summon. Wide tracking shot. THE WATER SWORDSMAN lowers his center of gravity into a deep combat stance on the damp forest floor under cold moonlight. He grips his katana with both hands, drawing a deep breath as cool mist swirls around his boots. MUST SHOW: A colossal crystalline blue water dragon condensing from his blade, coiling rapidly around his body with splashing water particles and glowing azure light illuminating the dark pine trunks.
SHOT 2 (00:06.0-00:07.0) — The Rival's Stance. Medium tracking shot. Across the clearing, THE LIGHTNING WARRIOR crouches extremely low in a tense iaijutsu quick-draw posture, fingers locked tightly onto his hilt, muscles coiled like a spring.
SHOT 3 (00:07.0-00:08.0) — Ground Blast. Dynamic push-in shot. The muddy ground beneath him suddenly fractures and explodes outwards, blasting dust, dirt, and scorched leaves into the air in a fiery corona.
SHOT 4 (00:08.0-00:11.2) — Lightning Dash. Fast whip-pan tracking shots. THE LIGHTNING WARRIOR instantly transforms into a blinding golden lightning afterimage, refracting and charging across the clearing in rapid zig-zag trajectories between towering pine trees.
SHOT 5 (00:11.2-00:12.6) — Counter-Rotation. Medium two-shot. THE WATER SWORDSMAN pivots sharply on his heel, swinging the roaring water dragon in a sweeping protective arc to meet the incoming charge.
SHOT 6 (00:12.6-00:13.6) — The Head-On Collision. Centered action shot. Both warriors slam head-on into the center of the frame, their steel blades locking in a violent kinetic impact.
SHOT 7 (00:13.6-00:15.1) — Energy Shockwave Climax. Wide expanding shot. The blue water dragon and golden lightning instantly detonate into a massive outward energy storm, snapping surrounding trees in half and leaving a blinding flash of white, blue, and yellow light. MUST SHOW: A concussive shockwave of vapor and electrical sparks obliterating the forest clearing.

SOUND:
Rushing torrents of water, deep wind gusts, cracking thunder, high-speed electric hums, sharp metallic katana strikes, and a deafening concussive blast.
prompt_short: A swordsman summons a swirling blue water dragon in a dark forest, while his rival charges forward as jagged golden lightning. Their blades collide in a blinding elemental explosion.
